p: we turned: They obeyed, after God had chastised them.
many days: Eight and thirty years, as in De 2:14.
coast of your brethren the children: This was the second time, before they had caused the Israelites to return, Nu 20:21.
blessed thee in all the works: And given you means, with which you may make recompence: also God will direct you by his providence, as he has done.
of Lot for a possession: Which were the Moabites and Ammonites.
Emims dwelt therein in times past: Signifying that as these giants were driven out for their sins: so the wicked when their sins are ripe, cannot avoid God's plagues.
space in which we came from: He shows by this, that as God is true in his promise, so his threatenings are not in vain.
hand of the LORD was against: His plague and punishment to destroy all that were twenty years old and above.
of giants: Who called themselves Rephaims: that is, preservers, or physicians to heal and reform vices: but were indeed Zamzummims, that is, wicked and abominable.
Amorite: According to his promise made to Abraham, Ge 15:16.
begin to put the dread of: This declares that the hearts of men are in God's hands either to be made faint, or bold.
children of Esau which dwell in: Because neither intreaty nor examples or others could move him, he could not complain of his just destruction.
hardened his spirit: God in his election and reprobation not only appoints the ends, but the means tending to the same.
women: God had cursed Canaan, and therefore he did not want any of the wicked race to be preserved.
